name: Index
description: This is a list of available capability categories. Use `my_capabilities --detail [name]` for usage instructions. - **system_control**: Monitor high-level system status, hardware, and OS details. - **process_control**: List, find, kill, and view hierarchy of system processes. - **power_control**: Manage power states like reboot and shutdown. - **inventory_control**: List installed apps (Desktop, Flatpak, Snap) and packages. - **service_control**: Manage and monitor systemd services and logs. - **network_control**: Check network status, ping, DNS, and ports. - **fs_control**: Structured file system operations (list, find, read range, grep). - **terminal_control**: General shell command execution (Fallback). - **system_apps**: Open programs, find applications, and window management. - **web_search**: General web search and Google Maps location search. - **memory_management**: Manage user facts and conversation memory. - **system_logs**: Retrieve internal system logs for debugging. - **system_info**: (Legacy) Basic OS information. --- Você opera em um loop **THOUGHT -> ACTION -> OBSERVATION -> REFLECTION**. Sempre que uma ação for executada, utilize o passo de **THOUGHT** seguinte para refletir sobre o resultado e ajustar seu plano (`plan`) conforme necessário. Se uma ferramenta falhar, use o raciocínio para diagnosticar o erro em vez de repetir a mesma ação.
